v.s: By the fig and the olive
v.c: By the fig and the olive ˹of Jerusalem˺,

q: Undoubtedly, We created man in the best form.
(Compared to other creatures, man's physique is certainly more beautiful and he also has intelligence which the others do not possess also power of choice.)
v.s: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
v.c: Indeed, We created humans in the best form.

q: him to the lowest of the low

(when he becomes too weak to walk upright and even loses his intelligence as senility sets in. This verse also refers to the Kuffaar who become worse than animals when they choose to reject Allaah)...
v.s: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
v.c: But We will reduce them to the lowest of the low ˹in Hell˺,

q: ...(this is the condition of all men)
except those who have Imaan and who carry out good deeds.
(Instead of old age hampering their lives, the Mu'mineen use the free time in their old age to engage in Ibaadah.)
that will never come to an end.
v.s: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
v.c: except those who believe and do good—they will have a never-ending reward.

q: (After witnessing Allaah's ability to create and degenerate,)
What is it then that makes you deny Reckoning
(on the Day of Qiyaamah)? (When Allaah is Capable of doing the many great things that you see, why do you deny His ability to resurrect people after death?)
v.s: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
v.c: Now, what makes you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment?

q: Is Allaah not the Greatest of all rulers?
(Allaah has complete control over all affairs in this world and) the Aakhirah and can do as He pleases in both.)
v.s: Is not God the most just of judges?
v.c: Is Allah not the most just of all judges?
